title.en: CORE Economy Units 1-4 atomic diagnostic question bank
title.zh_cn: CORE 经济学第 1-4 单元原子诊断题库

prompts.en: A country's nominal GDP rose by 8% while all prices rose by 8%; which GDP measure best indicates whether real output increased?
prompts.zh_cn: 某国名义 GDP 增长 8%，同期所有价格也上涨 8%；应使用哪一种 GDP 指标判断实际产出是否增长？

prompts.en: Why is purchasing-power-adjusted GDP per capita preferable to market-exchange-rate GDP per capita for comparing material living standards?
prompts.zh_cn: 为什么比较物质生活水平时，按购买力调整的人均 GDP 通常优于按市场汇率换算的人均 GDP？

prompts.en: A mayor says rising GDP per capita proves every resident is better off; how strong is that conclusion?
prompts.zh_cn: 某市长称人均 GDP 上升证明每位居民都过得更好；这一结论有多可靠？

prompts.en: Two countries have equal total GDP but populations of 5 million and 50 million; what does this imply about their average output per person?
prompts.zh_cn: 两国 GDP 总量相同，但人口分别为 500 万和 5000 万；这对两国人均产出意味着什么？

prompts.en: A system protects business assets, permits voluntary exchange, and organizes production through employers; which three capitalist institutions are present?
prompts.zh_cn: 某制度保护企业资产、允许自愿交换，并通过雇主组织生产；其中体现了哪三种资本主义制度？

prompts.en: What is the main coordination difference between a market exchange and production inside a firm?
prompts.zh_cn: 市场交换与企业内部生产在协调方式上的主要区别是什么？

prompts.en: A country has private shops but bans most exchange outside state quotas; does private property alone make the system fully capitalist?
prompts.zh_cn: 某国存在私人商店，但多数交换只能按国家配额进行；仅有私人财产是否足以使该制度成为完整的资本主义制度？

prompts.en: Workers follow a manager's production plan instead of bargaining over every task; which institution primarily coordinates their activity?
prompts.zh_cn: 工人按照管理者的生产计划工作，而不是逐项协商任务；主要由哪种制度协调这些活动？

prompts.en: Ana sacrifices two shirts to make one table while Bo sacrifices five; who has the comparative advantage in tables?
prompts.zh_cn: 安娜生产一张桌子要放弃两件衬衫，博生产一张桌子要放弃五件；谁在桌子生产上具有比较优势？

prompts.en: Why can two people gain from specialization even when one is more productive at both tasks?
prompts.zh_cn: 为什么即使一人在两项任务上都更高效，双方仍可能通过专业化获益？

prompts.en: If Mina's opportunity cost of coding falls relative to design, how should her specialization tend to change?
prompts.zh_cn: 如果米娜编程的机会成本相对于设计下降，她的专业化方向通常会如何变化？

prompts.en: A team assigns every task to its fastest member; what economic criterion might this rule overlook?
prompts.zh_cn: 一个团队把每项任务都交给完成速度最快的人；这种规则可能忽略什么经济标准？

prompts.en: A productivity series shows repeated upward shifts rather than one isolated jump; what feature makes this a permanent technological revolution?
prompts.zh_cn: 一条生产率序列呈现反复向上跃迁，而不是一次性跳升；什么特征使其体现持续的技术革命？

prompts.en: How can cost-reducing innovation raise labour productivity?
prompts.zh_cn: 降低成本的创新如何提高劳动生产率？

prompts.en: A patent lets an innovator temporarily sell below rivals' costs; what profit pattern should competition eventually produce?
prompts.zh_cn: 一项专利使创新者暂时能以低于竞争者成本的价格销售；竞争最终通常会带来怎样的利润变化？

prompts.en: A machine raises output but worsens pollution; does higher productivity alone establish higher overall wellbeing?
prompts.zh_cn: 一台机器提高了产出却加剧污染；仅凭更高生产率能否证明总体福祉提高？

prompts.en: Electricity improves factories, transport, and communication while enabling later inventions; what type of technology is it?
prompts.zh_cn: 电力改善工厂、交通和通信，并催生后续创新；它属于哪类技术？

prompts.en: What distinguishes a general-purpose technology from a process improvement used in one factory?
prompts.zh_cn: 通用技术与只在一家工厂使用的流程改进有何区别？

prompts.en: Britain had high wages and cheap coal before industrialization; what status should this fact have in an explanation of its early takeoff?
prompts.zh_cn: 工业化前英国工资较高且煤炭便宜；这一事实在解释英国率先起飞时应具有什么地位？

prompts.en: Countries with more factories have higher incomes; does this correlation show that factories alone caused the income difference?
prompts.zh_cn: 工厂更多的国家收入更高；这种相关性是否说明工厂本身造成了收入差异？

prompts.en: Students who study longer earn higher grades, but prior preparation affects both; what causal problem does prior preparation create?
prompts.zh_cn: 学习时间更长的学生成绩更高，但既有基础同时影响二者；既有基础造成了什么因果问题？

prompts.en: Why does a causal claim require reasoning about what would have happened without the proposed cause?
prompts.zh_cn: 为什么因果主张需要推理在缺少所提原因时会发生什么？

prompts.en: A city wants to estimate whether a training program raises wages; which comparison is most informative?
prompts.zh_cn: 某城市想估计培训项目是否提高工资；哪种比较最有信息量？

prompts.en: Why can omitting realistic details improve an economic model?
prompts.zh_cn: 为什么省略现实细节反而可能改进经济模型？

prompts.en: A model predicts study time effects while holding sleep constant; what does the ceteris paribus condition mean here?
prompts.zh_cn: 一个模型在睡眠时间不变时预测学习时间的影响；这里的其他条件不变意味着什么？

prompts.en: A simple model predicts poorly on every tested case; can simplicity alone justify keeping it?
prompts.zh_cn: 一个简单模型在所有测试案例上预测都很差；仅凭简单性是否足以保留它？

prompts.en: A model holds preferences fixed while the wage rises; what kind of model exercise studies the resulting choice change?
prompts.zh_cn: 一个模型在偏好不变时提高工资；研究由此产生的选择变化属于哪种模型分析？

prompts.en: Technique A uses much labour and little energy while technique B does the reverse; which becomes more attractive when energy prices fall?
prompts.zh_cn: 技术 A 大量使用劳动而少用能源，技术 B 则相反；能源价格下降时哪种技术会更有吸引力？

prompts.en: Two techniques lie on the same isocost line; what does that imply about their total cost at current input prices?
prompts.zh_cn: 两种技术位于同一条等成本线上；这对它们在当前投入价格下的总成本意味着什么？

prompts.en: A new technique lowers unit cost below the incumbent method; what economic reward initially motivates adoption?
prompts.zh_cn: 一种新技术把单位成本降到旧方法以下；最初推动采用它的经济回报是什么？

prompts.en: A superior technique is never adopted because replacing equipment is costly; is this necessarily irrational?
prompts.zh_cn: 一种更先进的技术因设备更换成本高而一直未被采用；这一定是不理性的吗？

prompts.en: How can a temporary productivity gain return income per person toward subsistence in a Malthusian model?
prompts.zh_cn: 在马尔萨斯模型中，暂时的生产率提高如何使人均收入重新趋向生存水平？

prompts.en: At which income level does population stop rising or falling in the simplified Malthusian model?
prompts.zh_cn: 在简化的马尔萨斯模型中，人口在哪一种收入水平上停止增长或下降？

prompts.en: A one-time harvest improvement raises income but not the long-run technology growth rate; what happens to long-run income per person in the model?
prompts.zh_cn: 一次性丰收提高了收入，但没有改变长期技术增长率；模型中的长期人均收入会怎样变化？

prompts.en: Fertility no longer rises with income in a modern economy; how well does the classic Malthusian feedback apply?
prompts.zh_cn: 在一个现代经济体中，生育率不再随收入上升；经典马尔萨斯反馈的适用性如何？

prompts.en: What must sustained technological progress do relative to population growth for living standards to rise?
prompts.zh_cn: 要使生活水平提高，持续技术进步相对于人口增长必须满足什么条件？

prompts.en: Both population and real wages rise for many decades; which Malthusian prediction does this pattern contradict?
prompts.zh_cn: 人口与实际工资连续数十年同时上升；这一模式与马尔萨斯模型的哪项预测相冲突？

prompts.en: Which change most directly weakens the Malthusian trap: faster recurring productivity growth or a one-time increase in land?
prompts.zh_cn: 哪种变化更直接削弱马尔萨斯陷阱：更快的持续生产率增长，还是一次性增加土地？

prompts.en: A curve maps each study-hour input to the maximum attainable exam score; what economic object does the curve represent?
prompts.zh_cn: 一条曲线把每种学习小时投入映射到可达到的最高考试分数；这条曲线代表什么经济对象？

prompts.en: What distinguishes a production function from one worker's observed output?
prompts.zh_cn: 生产函数与某位工人的一次实际产出有何区别？

prompts.en: A concave production function maps hours to output; what happens to output when hours increase?
prompts.zh_cn: 一条凹形生产函数把工时映射到产出；增加工时时产出会怎样变化？

prompts.en: A point lies above a stated production frontier; how should the model classify it?
prompts.zh_cn: 一个点位于给定生产前沿之上；模型应如何分类它？

prompts.en: Output rises from 40 to 46 when labour increases from 5 to 6 units; what is the marginal product of the sixth unit?
prompts.zh_cn: 劳动投入从 5 单位增至 6 单位时，产出从 40 增至 46；第六单位劳动的边际产量是多少？

prompts.en: A team produces 72 units with 8 workers; what is average product per worker?
prompts.zh_cn: 一个团队用 8 名工人生产 72 单位产品；每名工人的平均产量是多少？

prompts.en: Successive workers add 10, 8, then 5 units of output; what production pattern is present?
prompts.zh_cn: 连续增加的工人分别新增 10、8、5 单位产出；这里出现了什么生产规律？

prompts.en: How can marginal product fall while average product still rises?
prompts.zh_cn: 边际产量下降时，平均产量为何仍可能上升？

prompts.en: A bundle costs less than a student's budget; how is it classified relative to the budget constraint?
prompts.zh_cn: 一个组合的成本低于学生预算；相对于预算约束，它应如何分类？

prompts.en: A point lies on a feasible frontier; what does moving beyond it require?
prompts.zh_cn: 一个点位于可行前沿上；要移动到前沿之外需要什么？

prompts.en: A student's available time increases while task productivity stays fixed; how does the feasible set change?
prompts.zh_cn: 学生可用时间增加，而任务生产率不变；可行集会如何变化？

prompts.en: A feasible bundle uses resources wastefully and another bundle improves one outcome without reducing the other; is the first bundle efficient?
prompts.zh_cn: 一个可行组合浪费资源，且另一组合能在不降低一个结果的情况下改善另一个结果；前者是否有效率？

prompts.en: A frontier's slope is minus two units of leisure per grade point; what is the opportunity cost of one additional grade point?
prompts.zh_cn: 一条前沿的斜率为每增加一分成绩减少两单位闲暇；多一分成绩的机会成本是多少？

prompts.en: What is the relationship between the marginal rate of transformation and opportunity cost on a frontier?
prompts.zh_cn: 在一条前沿上，边际转换率与机会成本是什么关系？

prompts.en: A frontier becomes steeper at the current bundle; what happens to the opportunity cost of the horizontal-axis outcome?
prompts.zh_cn: 当前组合处的前沿变得更陡；横轴结果的机会成本会怎样变化？

prompts.en: A person says an extra hour of leisure is free because no money changes hands; what has been overlooked?
prompts.zh_cn: 有人称多一小时闲暇是免费的，因为没有金钱交易；这种说法忽略了什么？

prompts.en: Two bundles lie on the same indifference curve; what does this reveal about the chooser's ranking?
prompts.zh_cn: 两个组合位于同一条无差异曲线上；这说明决策者如何排序它们？

prompts.en: An indifference curve has an MRS of three at a bundle; what trade is the chooser locally willing to make?
prompts.zh_cn: 某组合处无差异曲线的边际替代率为 3；决策者局部愿意进行怎样的交换？

prompts.en: Can the numerical utility assigned to a bundle be read as a direct measurement of happiness?
prompts.zh_cn: 赋予某组合的效用数值能否被直接理解为幸福程度的测量？

prompts.en: A chooser strongly values scarce leisure at low leisure levels; how should the local MRS behave there?
prompts.zh_cn: 当闲暇很少时，决策者非常重视稀缺的闲暇；此处局部边际替代率通常会怎样？

prompts.en: At an interior optimum on a smooth frontier, which two marginal rates are equal?
prompts.zh_cn: 在平滑前沿上的内部最优点，哪两个边际率相等？

prompts.en: At a feasible bundle the MRS exceeds the MRT; which direction can improve the chooser's outcome locally?
prompts.zh_cn: 在一个可行组合处，边际替代率大于边际转换率；局部应朝哪个方向调整才能改善结果？

prompts.en: The best feasible choice is a corner with no smooth tangency; does failure of MRS equals MRT prove the choice is suboptimal?
prompts.zh_cn: 最佳可行选择位于不存在平滑切点的角点；边际替代率不等于边际转换率是否证明该选择非最优？

prompts.en: Why can a wage increase cause a person to choose more leisure?
prompts.zh_cn: 为什么工资上涨可能使一个人选择更多闲暇？

prompts.en: A higher wage makes each leisure hour more costly in foregone earnings; which effect does this describe?
prompts.zh_cn: 工资上涨使每小时闲暇对应的放弃收入增加；这描述的是哪种效应？

prompts.en: Can theory determine that every worker supplies more hours after a wage increase?
prompts.zh_cn: 理论能否断定每位劳动者在工资上涨后都会增加工时？

prompts.en: Two drivers independently choose left or right and receive outcomes from the pair of choices; what elements define this game?
prompts.zh_cn: 两名司机分别选择靠左或靠右，并由选择组合获得结果；哪些要素定义了这个博弈？

prompts.en: Given the other player's fixed action, which strategy should a self-interested player select?
prompts.zh_cn: 在另一位玩家行动固定时，自利玩家应选择哪种策略？

prompts.en: What makes a choice strategic rather than an isolated optimization problem?
prompts.zh_cn: 什么使一个选择成为战略选择，而不是孤立的最优化问题？

prompts.en: A subsidy raises the payoff from one action in every contingency; how can the player's best response change?
prompts.zh_cn: 一项补贴提高某行动在所有情形下的收益；玩家的最佳回应会如何变化？

prompts.en: An action gives a higher payoff regardless of the other player's choice; what kind of strategy is it?
prompts.zh_cn: 无论另一位玩家如何选择，某行动都带来更高收益；它属于哪类策略？

prompts.en: Both players choose their dominant actions but both would prefer the mutual alternative; what game structure is present?
prompts.zh_cn: 两位玩家都选择占优行动，但双方都更偏好共同采取另一行动；这里出现了什么博弈结构？

prompts.en: A fine lowers the payoff from defection below cooperation in every contingency; what happens to the dominant strategy?
prompts.zh_cn: 一项罚款使背叛在所有情形下的收益都低于合作；占优策略会怎样变化？

prompts.en: Does a dominant-strategy outcome necessarily maximize the players' total payoff?
prompts.zh_cn: 占优策略结果是否必然使玩家总收益最大？

prompts.en: At an action profile no player can gain by changing alone; what solution concept describes it?
prompts.zh_cn: 在一个行动组合中，没有玩家能通过单方面改变而获益；这属于哪种解概念？

prompts.en: A Nash equilibrium gives both players low payoffs; can it still be an equilibrium?
prompts.zh_cn: 一个纳什均衡给双方的收益都很低；它仍可能是均衡吗？

prompts.en: A payoff change makes one player's equilibrium action no longer a best response; what happens to the old equilibrium?
prompts.zh_cn: 收益变化使一名玩家的均衡行动不再是最佳回应；旧均衡会怎样？

prompts.en: A resident benefits from a clean park without contributing to maintenance; what behavior is this?
prompts.zh_cn: 一位居民不参与维护却享受整洁公园的好处；这是什么行为？

prompts.en: Contributors can exclude repeated non-contributors from future benefits; how should cooperation incentives change?
prompts.zh_cn: 贡献者可以在未来排除反复不贡献者；合作激励通常会如何变化？

prompts.en: Why is voluntary contribution difficult when a public good is non-excludable?
prompts.zh_cn: 当公共品具有非排他性时，为什么自愿贡献很困难？

prompts.en: A participant rejects an unequal offer once; does this single choice prove a fixed inequality-averse personality?
prompts.zh_cn: 一名参与者拒绝了一次不平等提议；这一选择是否证明其具有固定的厌恶不平等人格？

prompts.en: A player sacrifices money to reward a helpful partner; which social preference is most directly expressed?
prompts.zh_cn: 一名玩家牺牲自己的金钱来奖励提供帮助的伙伴；这最直接体现哪种社会偏好？
